messages:
sec_incident_bot: ALERT: Suspicious SSO token reuse pattern detected across multiple edge-auth logs. 50+ distinct user tokens showing short-lived shadowing from 3 IPs (eu-west-1). Flagged at 09:04 UTC. auto-pager -> sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: seeing the pager. acked, standing up triage channel. assigning roles.

alice_sec: any indication of customer data exfil? which pipelines touched the logs?

ben_p: initial query: auth.edge.* logs show repeated token validation from 3 IPs then immediate replays to internal /session/validate. Looks like token grabbed from log-forwarder stream and then replayed to edge. I can share short sample.

jordan_eng: confirmed: one of the log-forwarder instances in staging had an overly permissive sink config that forwarded debug payloads including auth headers to a third-party aggregator. Prod flag is OFF for that sink but I see an accidental config flip pushed to canary around 08:50 UTC.

sre-oncall: ok, priorities: 1) contain playback (block IPs + WAF rule) 2) rotate any service keys that might be exposed 3) assess customer impact 4) legal/forensics. ben, can you block the three IPs at edge? samops, start rotations for the log-forwarder svcacct + any deployed staging keys.

ben_p: applying short-term block now: `iptables` ACLs applied on edge-proxies, WAF rule created: `BLOCK from {54.12.34.56, 18.44.55.66, 3.120.77.88}`. propagation ~30s.

samops: starting key rotation for `log-forwarder-svc` and `canary-deployer` service account. plan: 1) create new keys in KMS 2) update k8s secrets in staging-only 3) rollout 50% 4) monitor. doing step 1 now.

alice_sec: need retention/erasure plan for any logs sent to third-party. who owns aggregator account? jordan?

jordan_eng: the aggregator is a third-party testing partner (contracted). I'm pulling the contract and account contact. sending list of indices that received data.

ben_p: edge blocks are in place. traffic from those IPs stopped. seeing reduced replay attempts in logs.

sre-oncall: good. samops — when keys rotated, will that invalidate tokens immediately or are there long TTL sessions? we should clear session caches too.

samops: rotation will prevent new token minting from those keys. existing sessions still valid until their TTL. recommending kv-cache purge on session-store and force session revalidate for affected tenants. plan snippet:
```
# purge keys (example)
redis-cli -h session-store flushdb --pattern "session:*tenantX*"
# OR set a short global TTL override for 10m
```

alice_sec: do NOT flush global session store blindly — potential customer outages. propose targeted tenant list from jordan before purge.

jordan_eng: list coming in 10m. initial list: tenant-a, tenant-b (low traffic), internal-dev accounts. I'll send exact session ids.

sre-oncall: agree targetted purges. legal, we should prepare customer notification if PII may be in forwarded logs.

legal: on it. please gather: affected tenant list, indices sent, sample payloads (redacted), timeline. we'll prepare a notice template and regulatory assessment.

ben_p: also created temporary fail-open guard on auth proxy to drop header echoes into debug fields. patched config in-flight on the proxy template.

alice_sec: forensics: capture the aggregator's indices, IPs that pulled the data, and any download logs. request immediate deletion and certificate of deletion from partner.

samops: rotation done for `log-forwarder-svc` and `canary-deployer`. secrets updated in staging. rollout 50% completed. keys created: `kms:rot-304321`.

sre-oncall: nice. samops, coordinate with jordan to push the partial rollback of the canary flip that enabled debug forwarding.

jordan_eng: rollback initiated for canary sink config -> staged. verifying no further hits to aggregator.

ben_p: replay attempts dropped to near-zero after blocks and rollback. still seeing sporadic validation attempts from one of the IPs (18.44.55.66) but they are failing 401.

alice_sec: snapshotting all relevant logs and sending to secure forensic bucket. saved a redacted sample for legal.

legal: received sample. prepping customer advisory drafts for tenant-a and tenant-b; will loop security for signoff.

sre-oncall: next steps: 1) finish targeted session purge for affected tenants (jordan + samops) 2) confirm aggregator deletion + certificate (jordan) 3) rotate any remaining staging/unbound keys (samops) 4) postmortem owner: alice_sec. handoff to day SRE at 16:00 UTC.

jordan_eng: confirmed certificate request sent to partner ops. they acked and will confirm deletion within 2 hours.

samops: running targeted session TTL override for tenant-a and tenant-b now (10m override then verify). will report when complete.

ben_p: monitoring dashboards show auth error spike during purge window, but traffic within expected degraded window for those tenants. no major customer impact reported to support yet.

alice_sec: collecting root cause notes for postmortem: mis-flagged canary push + missing gating in sink config + lack of production-only guard clauses.

sec_incident_bot: STATUS UPDATE: containment in progress. blocks + rollback + key rotations applied. estimated containment: 09:40 UTC. Forensics capture in progress.

sre-oncall: handing off to day on-call @day_sre for continued monitoring and customer comms. leave this thread pinned. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

day_sre: acked. taking over monitoring. will follow up on customer outreach and postmortem schedule.

alice_sec: assigning postmortem to myself. initial severity: P2 (possible sensitive header exposure to third-party). timeline begins 09:04 UTC.

legal: will wait for final evidence; standing by for escalation if regulatory thresholds hit.

samops: all rotations and targeted purges completed. marking tasks done in incident tracker.

ben_p: last check: no active replay attempts, edge-rate back to normal. closing monitoring in 1h unless new evidence.

sre-oncall: closing active incident channel and recording timeline. follow-up items in postmortem doc: config gating, sink validation tests, improve canary guard rails, automated session-cache invalidation tooling.

alice_sec: thanks all. will schedule 1-hour postmortem in 48h and share draft RCA beforehand. :white_check_mark:
